objective: Recover user-authorized staging-user APK build blocked before EAS by missing GitHub secret. Safely use the already tracked canonical multi-client Firebase config, which contains separately registered staging Android client org.mzbministry.buklod.staging, without creating fake Firebase credentials or changing the app source. Produce one finished signed APK, no OTA/web/Play.
productionBaselineEvidence: Verified live main commit edef58e4b564ec31a9065c700a4e2ce7a1b497dc contains PR583 release-only files. CI 42484376179 failed before EAS build because STAGING_FIREBASE_JSON_B64 GitHub secret was blank. Source has google-services.production.json with three verified distinct clients org.mzbministry.buklod, org.mzbministry.buklod.classroom and org.mzbministry.buklod.staging. No APK has been produced in this request yet.
chosenApproach: Keep protected-secret-first behavior, fall back only if canonical tracked multi-client Firebase file is present and exact staging package client exists. Copy to ignored google-services.staging.json in ephemeral GitHub Actions checkout; enforce package selection via Expo config, then original preview environment and EAS staging-user signed APK build and exact metadata validation. Branch/merge must preserve no source drift and no OTA/web/Play.
selectionRationale: The fallback uses actual registered package-specific Firebase configuration, not production package identity. The source already contains the exact required staging Firebase client, avoiding a separate missing repository secret and avoiding reconstructing keys. No user-private signing key or token is exposed.
alternativeApproaches: Retry unchanged GitHub secret gate: would fail identically, rejected.
Disable Firebase calls and build a degraded APK: would break features, rejected.
Invent staging Firebase client from production values: insecure/unverified, rejected.
Rebuild old staging source: stale source, rejected.
preserveBehaviors: Staging build only; Main app source, Expo runtime1.3.2, database, current OTA/web and Google Play unchanged.
Staging Firebase client package remains org.mzbministry.buklod.staging and preview EAS environment.
Original protected secret takes precedence when present; fallback validated against exact registered package.
acceptanceChecks: Workflow fails closed if neither protected secret nor source-registered staging client exists.
